```{r}
price_raw <- read_csv("data/kbh_quarter_sqm_price.csv")
rate_raw  <- read_csv("data/bondInt_quarterly.csv")

price <- price_raw |>
  mutate(
    qtr = yearquarter(str_replace(Quarter, "K", " Q")),
    Price = as.numeric(Price)
  ) |>
  select(qtr, Price) |>
  arrange(qtr) |>
  as_tsibble(index = qtr)

rate <- rate_raw |>
  mutate(
    qtr = yearquarter(str_replace(Quarter, "K", " Q")),
    rate = as.numeric(mean_rate)
  ) |>
  select(qtr, rate) |>
  arrange(qtr) |>
  as_tsibble(index = qtr)

df_raw <- inner_join(price, rate, by = "qtr") |>
  arrange(qtr) |>
  as_tsibble(index = qtr)

cat("Joined sample:", format(min(df_raw$qtr)), "to", format(max(df_raw$qtr)),
    " (n =", nrow(df_raw), ")\n")
```

```{r}
df_raw |>
  autoplot(Price) +
  labs(
    title = "Copenhagen housing prices",
    x = "Quarter",
    y = "Price per square metre"
  )
```

```{r}
df_raw |>
  autoplot(rate) +
  labs(
    title = "Long-term mortgage bond yield",
    x = "Quarter",
    y = "Bond yield"
  )
```



```{r}
df_model_raw <- df_raw |>
  mutate(
    rate_lag2 = dplyr::lag(rate, 2)
  ) |>
  drop_na(rate_lag2)
```


```{r}
n_test <- floor(nrow(df_model_raw) * 0.20)

train_raw <- df_model_raw |>
  slice_head(n = nrow(df_model_raw) - n_test)

test_raw <- df_model_raw |>
  slice_tail(n = n_test)

lambda_train <- train_raw |>
  features(Price, guerrero) |>
  pull(lambda_guerrero)

cat("Box-Cox lambda estimated on training data:", round(lambda_train, 4), "\n")
```

```{r}
df_model <- df_model_raw |>
  mutate(
    price_bc = box_cox(Price, lambda_train),
    price_bc_diff = difference(price_bc),
    rate_diff = difference(rate)
  )

train <- df_model |>
  slice_head(n = nrow(df_model) - n_test)

test <- df_model |>
  slice_tail(n = n_test)
```

```{r}
cat("Test rows:", nrow(test), "\n")
cat("NA in price_bc:", sum(is.na(test$price_bc)), "\n")
cat("NA in price_bc_diff:", sum(is.na(test$price_bc_diff)), "\n")
cat("NA in rate_lag2:", sum(is.na(test$rate_lag2)), "\n")
```

```{r}
components(decomp_price) |>

```

```{r}
stationarity_table <- tibble(
  Series = c(
    "Housing price, Box-Cox level",
    "Housing price, Box-Cox difference",
    "Bond yield, level",
    "Bond yield, difference"
  ),
  variable = c("price_bc", "price_bc_diff", "rate", "rate_diff")
) |>
  mutate(
    data = map(variable, ~ {
      if (.x == "price_bc") {
        train$price_bc
      } else if (.x == "price_bc_diff") {
        train |> filter(!is.na(price_bc_diff)) |> pull(price_bc_diff)
      } else if (.x == "rate") {
        train$rate
      } else {
        train |> filter(!is.na(rate_diff)) |> pull(rate_diff)
      }
    }),

    adf_model = map(data, ~ ur.df(.x, type = "drift", selectlags = "AIC")),
    ADF_stat = map_dbl(adf_model, ~ .x@teststat[1]),
    ADF_crit_5pct = map_dbl(adf_model, ~ .x@cval[1, "5pct"]),

    kpss_model = map(data, ~ ur.kpss(.x, type = "mu")),
    KPSS_stat = map_dbl(kpss_model, ~ .x@teststat),

    # KPSS 5% critical value for type = "mu"
    KPSS_crit_5pct = 0.463,

    ADF_stationary = ADF_stat < ADF_crit_5pct,
    KPSS_stationary = KPSS_stat < KPSS_crit_5pct,

    Stationary = if_else(ADF_stationary & KPSS_stationary, "Yes", "No")
  ) |>
  select(Series, ADF_stat, KPSS_stat, Stationary) |>
  mutate(
    ADF_stat = round(ADF_stat, 3),
    KPSS_stat = round(KPSS_stat, 3)
  )

stationarity_table_plot <- stationarity_table |>
  rename(
    `ADF stat` = ADF_stat,
    `KPSS stat` = KPSS_stat
  )

gridExtra::grid.table(
  stationarity_table_plot,
  rows = NULL
)
```

```{r}
adf_results <- tibble(
  series = c("price_bc", "price_bc_diff", "rate", "rate_diff"),
  adf_stat = c(
    ur.df(train$price_bc, type = "drift", selectlags = "AIC")@teststat[1],
    ur.df(train |> filter(!is.na(price_bc_diff)) |> pull(price_bc_diff),
          type = "drift", selectlags = "AIC")@teststat[1],
    ur.df(train$rate, type = "drift", selectlags = "AIC")@teststat[1],
    ur.df(train |> filter(!is.na(rate_diff)) |> pull(rate_diff),
          type = "drift", selectlags = "AIC")@teststat[1]
  ),
  critical_5pct = c(
    ur.df(train$price_bc, type = "drift", selectlags = "AIC")@cval[1, "5pct"],
    ur.df(train |> filter(!is.na(price_bc_diff)) |> pull(price_bc_diff),
          type = "drift", selectlags = "AIC")@cval[1, "5pct"],
    ur.df(train$rate, type = "drift", selectlags = "AIC")@cval[1, "5pct"],
    ur.df(train |> filter(!is.na(rate_diff)) |> pull(rate_diff),
          type = "drift", selectlags = "AIC")@cval[1, "5pct"]
  )
) |>
  mutate(
    stationary_adf = if_else(adf_stat < critical_5pct, "Yes", "No")
  )

adf_results
```

```{r}
var_data <- train |>
  filter(!is.na(price_bc_diff), !is.na(rate_diff)) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(price_bc_diff, rate_diff)
```

```{r}
lag_select <- vars::VARselect(var_data, lag.max = 8, type = "const")
lag_select$selection 

```

```{r}
p_opt <- lag_select$selection["SC(n)"]

fit_var <- vars::VAR(var_data, p = p_opt, type = "const")
summary(fit_var)

```

```{r}
vars::serial.test(fit_var, lags.pt = 8, type = "PT.asymptotic")

var_forecast <- predict(fit_var, n.ahead = nrow(test))

price_diff_fc <- var_forecast$fcst$price_bc_diff[, "fcst"]
```

```{r}
last_train_price <- tail(train$price_bc, 1)
price_bc_fc <- cumsum(c(last_train_price, price_diff_fc))[-1]

```

```{r}
var_accuracy <- tibble(
  .model = "var",
  RMSE = sqrt(mean((price_bc_fc - test$price_bc)^2)),
  MAE  = mean(abs(price_bc_fc - test$price_bc)),
  MAPE = mean(abs((price_bc_fc - test$price_bc) / test$price_bc)) * 100
)

bind_rows(accuracy_models_clean, var_accuracy) |>
  arrange(RMSE)
```

```{r}
tibble(
  qtr = test$qtr,
  actual = test$price_bc,
  var_fc = price_bc_fc
) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = qtr)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = actual), colour = "black") +
  geom_line(aes(y = var_fc), colour = "steelblue", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "VAR forecast vs actual (test period)",
    x = "Quarter",
    y = "Box-Cox transformed housing price"
  )
```


```{r}
# Forecast from VAR model
fc_var <- predict(fit_var, n.ahead = nrow(test), ci = 0.95)

# Extract forecasted changes in transformed housing prices
point_fc <- fc_var$fcst$price_bc_diff[, "fcst"]
lower_95 <- fc_var$fcst$price_bc_diff[, "lower"]
upper_95 <- fc_var$fcst$price_bc_diff[, "upper"]

# Approximate 80% interval from the 95% interval
se <- (upper_95 - point_fc) / 1.96
lower_80 <- point_fc - 1.28 * se
upper_80 <- point_fc + 1.28 * se

# Last observed transformed housing price in training data
last_train_price <- train |>
  slice_tail(n = 1) |>
  pull(price_bc)

# Reconstruct forecasts from differences back to transformed price level
df_var_forecast <- tibble(
  qtr = test$qtr,
  model = "VAR",
  value = cumsum(c(last_train_price, point_fc))[-1],
  lower_80 = cumsum(c(last_train_price, lower_80))[-1],
  upper_80 = cumsum(c(last_train_price, upper_80))[-1],
  lower_95 = cumsum(c(last_train_price, lower_95))[-1],
  upper_95 = cumsum(c(last_train_price, upper_95))[-1]
)

# Full historical actual series, not just from 2015
df_actual <- df_model |>
  select(qtr, value = price_bc)

# Plot like S152986
ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = df_actual,
    aes(x = qtr, y = value, colour = "Actual"),
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = df_var_forecast,
    aes(x = qtr, ymin = lower_95, ymax = upper_95, fill = "VAR 95%"),
    alpha = 0.20
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = df_var_forecast,
    aes(x = qtr, ymin = lower_80, ymax = upper_80, fill = "VAR 80%"),
    alpha = 0.40
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = df_var_forecast,
    aes(x = qtr, y = value, colour = "VAR forecast"),
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name = "Series",
    values = c(
      "Actual" = "black",
      "VAR forecast" = "blue"
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Prediction interval",
    values = c(
      "VAR 95%" = "blue",
      "VAR 80%" = "blue"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "VAR forecast of transformed housing prices",
    x = "Quarter",
    y = "Box-Cox transformed housing price"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```



```{r}
qlr_df <- train |>
  filter(!is.na(price_bc_diff), !is.na(rate_diff)) |>
  as_tibble()

qlr <- Fstats(price_bc_diff ~ rate_diff, data = qlr_df)

plot(qlr,
     main = "QLR Test: F-statistics across candidate breakpoints",
     xlab = "Quarter")

breakpoints(qlr)

sctest(qlr)
```

```{r}
bp <- breakpoints(qlr)
print(bp)

qlr_df[bp$breakpoints, "qtr"]

break_qtr <- qlr_df[bp$breakpoints, "qtr"] |> pull(qtr)

train_pre  <- train |> filter(qtr <= break_qtr)
train_post <- train |> filter(qtr >  break_qtr)


fit_pre <- train_pre |>
  model(arimax_lag2 = ARIMA(price_bc ~ rate_lag2))

report(fit_pre)


fit_pre |>
  augment() |>
  features(.innov, ljung_box, lag = 8, dof = 0)
```
